factories.name: newFindRecordsStep
factories.description: Find up to 200 records of one module whose fields match every condition, such as a contact by email or an account by name, through a COQL query with typed, escaped values; results are immediate, with no search-index delay, and an offset cursor reads the next page.

COQLValue.description: COQLValue is one typed value of a condition. Build it with COQLText, COQLTextList, COQLNumber, COQLBoolean, COQLDate, COQLDateTime, COQLRecordID, or COQLRecordIDList, so a value can never change the query around it.

boolean.description: Boolean holds the value of a boolean.

text.description: Text holds the value for every kind except the lists and boolean.

texts.description: Texts holds the entries of a list.

RecordCondition.description: RecordCondition is one COQL criterion: a field path, a comparator, and a typed value.

field.description: Field is a field API name, such as Email, or a lookup path with at most two joins, such as Account_Name.Account_Name.

value.description: Value is the typed value; it is nil for is null and is not null, and a list for in and not in.

RecordSort.description: RecordSort orders results by one field; record ID breaks ties in ascending order.

field.description: Field is the field API name to order by, such as Modified_Time.

isDescending.description: IsDescending orders from the highest value instead of the lowest.

inputSchema.description: FindRecordsInput finds records of one module whose fields match every condition.

conditions.description: Conditions are 1 to 10 criteria that every returned record matches, such as Email = jane@acme.example.com.

fields.description: Fields are 1 to 50 field API names or lookup paths to return, such as Email and Account_Name; the record ID is always returned.

limit.description: Limit is the page size, 1 to 200; zero uses DefaultFindRecordsLimit.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Contacts.

offset.description: Offset skips that many matches; pass the previous page's NextOffset to read the next page.

sort.description: Sort orders the page by one field and then by record ID; nil orders by record ID.

factories.name: newGetRecordStep
factories.description: Read one record of a module by record ID, with every field or the chosen fields, including lookups such as a contact's account and a deal's owner.

inputSchema.description: GetRecordInput reads one record by ID.

fields.description: Fields are up to 50 field API names to return; empty returns every field of the record.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Deals.

recordId.description: RecordID is the record ID, such as 4150868000000376008.

factories.name: newListModifiedRecordsStep
factories.description: List up to 200 records of one module modified at or after a time, oldest change first, and return a watermark cursor that reads the next page now or the next changes in a later poll.

inputSchema.description: ListModifiedRecordsInput lists records of one module changed at or after a point, oldest change first. Set ModifiedSince for the first page of a new feed, or Cursor to continue one.

cursor.description: Cursor continues a feed after the last record of a previous page. Leave it empty when ModifiedSince is set.

fields.description: Fields are 1 to 49 field API names to return; Modified_Time is always added.

limit.description: Limit is the page size, 1 to 200; zero uses DefaultListModifiedRecordsLimit.

modifiedSince.description: ModifiedSince starts a feed at records modified at or after this instant, in whole seconds. Leave it zero when Cursor is set.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Deals.

factories.name: newUpsertRecordStep
factories.description: Create one record, or update the record whose duplicate-check field, such as a contact's Email or a unique external ID field, already holds the value, so a retried Step updates the record an earlier attempt created instead of creating a duplicate.

inputSchema.description: UpsertRecordInput creates one record, or updates the record whose duplicate-check field already holds the value Fields gives it.

duplicateCheckFields.description: DuplicateCheckFields are 1 to 3 field API names Zoho CRM checks in order, such as Email for Contacts, Account_Name for Accounts, or a custom field marked Do not allow duplicate values. Each must be set in Fields to a non-empty value, so a repeated attempt finds the record.

fields.description: Fields are 1 to 200 field values by API name, such as {"Email": "\"jane@acme.example.com\""}; lookups are written as {"id": "<record ID>"} with LookupFieldValue. The record ID cannot be set.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Contacts.

shouldSkipAutomation.description: ShouldSkipAutomation runs no workflow rule, approval, or blueprint after the write.

triggers.description: Triggers limits the automations Zoho CRM runs after the write; empty keeps Zoho CRM's default, which runs workflow rules, approvals, and blueprints.

factories.name: newUpdateRecordStep
factories.description: Set the named fields of one record by record ID, such as a deal's Stage or Owner, leaving every other field unchanged; repeating the update sets the same values again.

inputSchema.description: UpdateRecordInput sets named fields of one record; every other field keeps its value.

fields.description: Fields are 1 to 200 field values by API name, such as Stage and Owner; JSON null clears a field, and lookups are written as {"id": "<record ID>"} with LookupFieldValue.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Deals.

recordId.description: RecordID is the record ID, such as 4150868000000376008.

shouldSkipAutomation.description: ShouldSkipAutomation runs no workflow rule, approval, or blueprint after the write.

triggers.description: Triggers limits the automations Zoho CRM runs after the write; empty keeps Zoho CRM's default, which runs workflow rules, approvals, and blueprints.

factories.name: newListModuleFieldsStep
factories.description: List the fields of one module with their API names, data types, unique and custom flags, lookup modules, and picklist values, such as the stages a deal's Stage accepts.

inputSchema.description: ListModuleFieldsInput names the module whose fields to list.

module.description: Module is the module API name, such as Deals.
